author: AlbertWesker98
quote: Clear downgrade to past GTA games, crime profile decentivizes players from doing crime in a GTA game, boring opening with doing chores around the house, and alot of things were cut for this game, like hiring hookers, rampages, no mission replay, no businesses owning, no stock market, no web browsing in the phone. You dont actually have the gangster vibe from past GTA games, its more a Sims vibe, buying flowers for GF, building furniture, etc etc. Big disappointment
